title: New Beginnings
author: Alphi
desc:
Each day starts with cardio on an incline with the goal of burning 400cals.

Exercises are given a broad rep range to indicate that they should be performed to technical failure. Use a weight that allows you to perform as many controlled repetitions as possible while maintaining proper form. The number of repetitions may vary from session to session depending on energy and fatigue. If you consistently exceed the upper end of the range, increase the weight for subsequent sets and future sessions.

Each session has dynamic stretches integrated to the beginning of the session and static stretches to the end of the sessions.

At the end of every week there’s a swimming session.
